description: This file defines the QueryInterface interface for entity queries in Drupal, including method signatures for building and executing entity database queries, managing conditions, sorting, revisions, and access control.

classes.name: QueryInterface
classes.description: Interface for entity queries, extending AlterableInterface, providing method signatures for query building, conditions, sorting, revisions, and execution.

methods.name: getEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the entity type ID for this query.

methods.name: condition
methods.description: Adds a condition or condition group to the query, supporting complex field queries with operators and language filtering.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Queries for a non-empty value on a specified field.

methods.name: notExists
methods.description: Queries for an empty value on a specified field.

methods.name: pager
methods.description: Enables pagination with a specified limit and optional element index.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Defines the range of records to return from the query.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts the result set by a specified field and direction, with optional language filtering.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Converts the query into a count query, returning the number of entities found.

methods.name: tableSort
methods.description: Enables sortable tables for the query based on provided headers.

methods.name: accessCheck
methods.description: Enables or disables access checking for the query.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the query, returning entity IDs or count.

methods.name: andConditionGroup
methods.description: Creates a new condition group combined with AND logic.

methods.name: orConditionGroup
methods.description: Creates a new condition group combined with OR logic.

methods.name: currentRevision
methods.description: Limits the query to only default revisions.

methods.name: latestRevision
methods.description: Queries for the latest revision of entities.

methods.name: allRevisions
methods.description: Includes all revisions in the query.
